correctness.rationale: A self-contained exact verifier constructs the 30-vertex incidence graph of the symplectic generalized quadrangle over \(\mathbb F_2\), enumerates all localized length-5 magnitude chains in degrees 2, 3 and 4 for every endpoint pair, constructs the standard magnitude differentials, checks the chain condition, and computes exact \(\mathbb F_2\) ranks. The only opposite-side profiles are distance 1 with beta 0 and distance 3 with beta 4; 360 distance-3 ordered pairs give total dimension 1440. Same-side blocks are empty by bipartite parity. The eight-cycle count is independently exhaustive.

value.rationale: The graph is the unique \((3,8)\)-cage, so it is a canonical extremal object at the precise girth-eight boundary of known second-off-diagonal vanishing. The exact endpoint profile distinguishes adjacent and distance-three pairs and ties the surviving local rank to the four eight-cycles through the unique three-edge geodesic. This is a motivated boundary invariant rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
